name: Claudebar
author: mryll
description: Claude AI plan usage (claudebar) in the Omarchy bar: session, weekly, and per-model limits with pacing.

barWidget.description: Click: usage panel. Middle click: force refresh. Right click: open the claude.ai usage page.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run the CLI. The API response is cached for 60s, so anything below that re-reads the same cached answer — and the usage endpoint rate-limits hard: under 300s it usually answers HTTP 429. Opening the panel and middle-clicking the bar both force a fresh fetch regardless.

schema.label: Show usage % next to the icon
schema.description: Horizontal bars only. A vertical bar always shows just the icon; the panel is one click away either way.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.

schema.label: Window shown on the bar
schema.description: Which usage window drives the percentage shown on the bar. Any other window that runs out still reaches you through the alarm dot and the panel.
